title: Sink Or Float Worksheets | Kindergarten Science Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:

Give your learners extra practice with Sink Or Float! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

  • Which One Sinks?

PERFECT FOR

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Sink or Float?, Will It Float?, Which One Sinks?), so children can play, then print and practice
